data.description: Wearer is considered one size category larger for the purpose of using or being affected by special attacks that depend on size, such as swallow whole and trample. Once per day on command, the wearer can increase her size as if using enlarge person for 1 minute. Once per minute as a free action add the armor's enhancement bonus to a single strength check or combat maneuver check, or to her CMD against a single combat maneuver. The armor check penalty of titanic armor is increased by an abilities amount equal to its enhancement bonus.
